what: A groovebox for the FM-1 with three synth tracks, four drum lanes, 24 Plaits engines, 128 starting sounds, a pattern arranger and a 64-step sequencer. Shape your mix with track effects, shared reverb and master controls.
author: Aaron Grando
sounds: licensed: wavetables and DX7 patch banks from Mutable Instruments Plaits, MIT. Drum kits are synthesised by this project, CC0
